title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
abstract: arXiv:2610.22192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Ha

translated_title: Terminal-RSI：通过递归自重写与策略精炼实现递归自我提升的终端智能体
translated_abstract: 将验证器的结果转化为有效的策略更新，并将部分进展转化为完整的任务解决，这对终端智能体至关重要。我们提出了 Terminal-RSI，它在已验证轨迹的递归自重写（RSR）与继承评论家模型的递归策略精炼（RPR）之间交替进行。我们提出了回合边界跳过观察 GAE（TB-GAE），在跨交互回合应用衰减的同时保留特定于 token 的基线。家族密集奖励（FDR）校准跨任务家族的语义进展；成功优先奖励（SPR）将严格成功与有界的部分得分区分开来。预热评论家模型、递归评论家交接以及阶段特定的学习率协调了两个精炼阶段。从 Qwen3.8-27B 基础模型出发，经过 RSR-1、RPR-1、RSR-2 和 RPR-2 的五阶段序列，最终得到 Terminal-RSI-27B：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上达到 19.84%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 86.52%，在 Terminal-Bench 3.0 上达到 16.95%，在 Terminal-Bench Ha 上达到 79.00%。
tldr: Terminal-RSI 通过将已验证轨迹的递归自重写与继承评论家的递归策略精炼交替进行，并辅以 TB-GAE、家族密集奖励和成功优先奖励等机制，实现了终端智能体的递归自我提升，在多个 Terminal-Bench 基准上取得领先性能。
en_tdlr: Terminal-RSI alternates recursive self-rewrite of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting recursive policy-refine, enabling recursive self-improvement of terminal agents that achieves leading performance across multiple Terminal-Bench benchmarks.
